# Introduction

This report summarizes the differential usage results of `S07c-satuRn_DTU.R` for a single ENDome, and compares the different runs that were produced for it. 

A run is a combination of a pseudobulk preset (`pseudobulk_settings`) and a satuRn profile (`satuRn_settings`). Each run is read from the name of its result files (`<endome>.<pseudobulk>.<profile>.satuRn.condition.tsv` and `.condition.diagnostics.tsv`), so every table and figure has one tab per run. The script `S07c` runs one fit per stratum x cell type. Here, a stratum is a value of the sample-table column given by `stratify_by` in the configuration, and all samples when `stratify_by` is null. Default behavior is to stratify by tissue/region.

The report aims to cover five aspects:

1. **Which fits ran**: how many stratum x cell type fits reached satuRn, with how many samples, genes and bins, and why the others were skipped.
2. **How well calibrated are the tests**: the empirical null estimated by satuRn and the p-value distributions, which decide how much of the signal survives.
3. **What is differentially used**: significant genes per cell type and contrast, their effect sizes, and in which direction the usage moves along the gene.
4. **The genes of interest and the top hits**: with the bin usage of every sample.
5. **How the runs agree**: overlap and rank concordance of every run with the others.

## Report settings {-}

Settings of the figures and tables:

```{r report-settings}
params <- snakemake@params

genes_of_interest <- unlist(params$genes_of_interest)   # "Genes of interest" section (gene symbols)
top_genes <- params$top_genes %||% 6                    # genes in "Top genes"
max_table_rows <- 200                                   # rows of the "Significant genes" table
n_volcano_celltypes <- 3                                # cell types in "Effect sizes" (most bins tested first)
default_alpha <- 0.05                                   # when a run's satuRn profile is not in the config
default_min_cells <- 5                                  # idem, for the samples shown in the usage plots

## Colors
col_sig <- "#b2182b" # significant gene / bin
col_not_sig <- "grey70" # not significant
col_skipped <- "grey85" # skipped test (tiles)
col_bars <- "#2166ac" # histograms

col_direction <- c(`More used in group 1` = "#b2182b", `Less used in group 1` = "#2166ac")

col_overlap <- c(Neither = "grey75", `Other run only` = "#ef8a62", `This run only` = "#67a9cf", Both = "#b2182b")
col_stratum <- c(ACG = "#7552a5", IPL = "#c6b4df")
col_contrast <- c(PDDvsControl = "#4B8D86",
                  PDvsControl = "#E88247",
                  PDDvsPD = "#2F4B7C") 
col_unknown <- "grey60"

## Tabsets
```

## File paths {-}

```{r script-paths}
# Snakemake inputs
smk_inputs <- snakemake@input
smk_outputs <- snakemake@output
wc <- snakemake@wildcards

pseudobulk_settings <- params$pseudobulk_settings
satuRn_settings <- params$satuRn_settings
comparison <- params$comparison
stratify_by <- comparison$stratify_by
exclude_samples <- as.character(unlist(comparison$exclude_samples))
contrast_groups <- unique(unlist(strsplit(unlist(comparison$contrasts), "-", fixed = TRUE)))

## Name of the stratum in tables and legends (e.g. "Region")
stratum_name <- if (is.null(stratify_by)) "Stratum" else tools::toTitleCase(stratify_by)

#' Run of an input file, read from its name
#' 
#' @param path File paths
#' @param suffix Regular expression of the suffix (one of file_suffix)
#' @return The paths, named by their run
runFromPath <- function(path, suffix) {
  path <- unlist(path)
  if (length(path) == 0) return(stats::setNames(character(0), character(0)))
  run <- sub(paste0("^.*\\.w[^.]+\\.[35]p\\.(.+)\\.", suffix, "$"), "\\1", basename(path))
  unparsed <- run == basename(path)
  if (any(unparsed)) stop("Cannot read the run from: ", paste(path[unparsed], collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  stats::setNames(path.expand(path), run)
}

## Runs
results_paths <- runFromPath(smk_inputs$results, file_suffix[["results"]])
diagnostics_paths <- runFromPath(smk_inputs$diagnostics, file_suffix[["diagnostics"]])
pseudobulk_paths <- runFromPath(smk_inputs$pseudobulk, file_suffix[["pseudobulk"]])
n_cells_paths <- runFromPath(smk_inputs$n_cells, file_suffix[["n_cells"]])
sample_table_path <- path.expand(smk_inputs$sample_table)

runs <- intersect(names(results_paths), names(diagnostics_paths))
unpaired <- setdiff(union(names(results_paths), names(diagnostics_paths)), runs)
if (length(unpaired) > 0) warning("Runs without both results and diagnostics (left out): ", paste(unpaired, collapse = ", "))
if (length(runs) == 0) stop("No run has both results and diagnostics", call. = FALSE)

run_info <- tibble::tibble(
  run = runs,
  pseudobulk = sub("\\..*$", "", runs),
  profile = dplyr::if_else(grepl("\\.", runs), sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", runs), "-"),
  label = paste0(pseudobulk, " / ", profile),
  tab_label = paste0("Pseudobulk: ", pseudobulk, "<br>satuRn: ", profile)    # tab headers (HTML)
)
run_labels <- stats::setNames(run_info$label, run_info$run)
tab_labels <- stats::setNames(run_info$tab_label, run_info$run)

## Tab layout
n_rows <- ceiling(length(runs) / max_tabs_per_row)
n_cols <- min(max(ceiling(length(runs) / n_rows), 2), 7)
tab_class <- paste0(".tabset .", tab_style, n_cols)

### Truncation site of the ENDome: which end defines the bins
tx_end <- stringr::str_extract(wc$endome_name, "(3p|5p)$")

### Helper library
lib_dir <- path.expand(file.path(snakemake@scriptdir, "../lib"))
if(!dir.exists(lib_dir)) lib_dir <- path.expand(file.path(snakemake@scriptdir, "lib"))
source(file.path(lib_dir, "hf-notebooks.R"))
```

## Helper functions {-}

```{r helper-functions}
# Formatting functions
fmtInt <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
fmtPct <- function(x, accuracy = 0.1) scales::percent(x, accuracy = accuracy)
fmtP <- function(x) dplyr::if_else(is.na(x), "-", formatC(x, format = "g", digits = 3))

#' A config value as text: "null", "a, b" or, for nested settings, "key = value, ..."
fmtSetting <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return("null")
  v <- unlist(v)
  if (is.null(names(v))) paste(v, collapse = ", ") else paste(names(v), v, sep = " = ", collapse = ", ")
}

#' Read an S07c output
readSaturn <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("\\.rds$", path)) readRDS(path) else readr::read_tsv(path, guess_max = Inf)
}

#' Write one tab per run
#'
#' `fun(run)` returns a ggplot, a kable or NULL
renderTabsetByRun <- function(tabsetFun, level = 3){
  invisible(
    lapply(seq_along(runs), function(i){
      r <- runs[[i]]
      cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", tab_labels[[r]], " {-}\n\n", sep = "")
      
      tryCatch({
        output <- tabsetFun(r)
        if (inherits(output, "ggplot")) {
          print(output)
        }else if(inherits(output, c("knitr_table", "kableExtra"))){
          print(output)
        }else if (inherits(output, c("htmlwidget", "shiny.tag", "shiny.tag.list"))) {
          ## Widgets (e.g. DT) need knit_print to register their JS/CSS dependencies
          kp <- knitr::knit_print(output)
          knitr::knit_meta_add(attr(kp, "knit_meta"))
          cat(kp)
        }else if(!is.null(output)){
          print(output)
        }
      }, error = function(e) cat("*Not available for this run: ", conditionMessage(e), "*\n\n"))
      cat("\n\n")
    })
  )
}

#' Setting of the satuRn profile of a run, or `default` if the profile is not in the config
runSetting <- function(r, key, default = NULL) {
  profile <- run_info$profile[run_info$run == r]
  satuRn_settings[[profile]][[key]] %||% default
}

#' Rename the stratification column of S07c's outputs to "stratum"
toStratum <- function(df, path) {
  if (is.null(stratify_by)) return(dplyr::mutate(df, stratum = "all", .after = "endome"))
  if (!stratify_by %in% colnames(df)) {
    stop("Column '", stratify_by, "' (stratify_by) not in ", path, ". Was it built with another stratify_by?", call. = FALSE)
  }
  dplyr::rename(df, stratum = dplyr::all_of(stratify_by)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(stratum = as.character(stratum))
}

#' Rename the "stratum" column of a table for display (e.g. to "Region")
showStratum <- function(df) dplyr::rename(df, !!stratum_name := stratum)

#' Index of the minimum, NA when every value is NA
whichMinSafe <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_integer_ else which.min(x)

#' -log10 with a floor, so p = 0 can be drawn
nlog10 <- function(p) -log10(pmax(p, 1e-300))

#' Named colors for the values of `x` (in facet order): from `palette`, or `col_unknown`
colorsFor <- function(x, palette) {
  x <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(droplevels(x)) else sort(unique(as.character(x)))
  stats::setNames(dplyr::coalesce(unname(palette[x]), col_unknown), x)
}

#' Facet strips filled with the color of their stratum (for ggh4x::facet_wrap2 / facet_grid2)
stratumStrips <- function(stratum) {
  ggh4x::strip_themed(background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = unname(colorsFor(stratum, col_stratum))))
}
```

## Data loading {-}

Results, diagnostics, gene-level summaries and gene symbols for every run, and the sample table, pseudobulks and nuclei counts for the usage plots.

```{r load-data, cache=TRUE}
# Load results
## Empty template for missing runs
empty_results <- tibble::tibble(
  endome = character(0), stratum = character(0), celltype = character(0), contrast = character(0),
  gene_id = character(0), isoform_id = character(0), estimates = numeric(0), pval = numeric(0),
  empirical_pval = numeric(0), p_used = numeric(0), gene_qvalue = numeric(0),
  stageR_gene = numeric(0), stageR_transcript = numeric(0))

## Load results from input paths
results <- lapply(runs, function(r) {
  x <- readSaturn(results_paths[[r]]) %>% toStratum(results_paths[[r]])
  if (nrow(x) == 0) x <- empty_results
  x
}) %>% stats::setNames(runs)

# Load diagnostics
diagnostics <- lapply(runs, function(r) readSaturn(diagnostics_paths[[r]]) %>% toStratum(diagnostics_paths[[r]])) %>%
  stats::setNames(runs)
alpha <- vapply(runs, function(r) as.numeric(runSetting(r, "alpha", default_alpha)), numeric(1))

# Load gene results

## Gene symbols from org.Hs.eg.db when available; the gene id otherwise (e.g. novel MSTRG genes)
all_gene_ids <- unique(unlist(lapply(results, function(x) x$gene_id)))
gene_symbol <- stats::setNames(all_gene_ids, all_gene_ids)
if (length(all_gene_ids) > 0 && requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ens <- sub("\\..*$", "", all_gene_ids)
  sym <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique(ens[grepl("^ENSG", ens)]),
                                                keytype = "ENSEMBL", column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first"))
  gene_symbol[] <- dplyr::coalesce(unname(sym[ens]), all_gene_ids)
}

## Gene-level summary of every test
genes <- lapply(runs, function(r) {
  results[[r]] %>%
    dplyr::group_by(stratum, celltype, contrast, gene_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_bins = dplyr::n(),
      min_p = suppressWarnings(min(p_used, na.rm = TRUE)),
      gene_qvalue = dplyr::first(gene_qvalue),
      stageR_gene = dplyr::first(stageR_gene),
      n_sig_bins = sum(stageR_transcript < alpha[[r]], na.rm = TRUE),
      best_bin = isoform_id[whichMinSafe(p_used)][1],
      best_estimate = estimates[whichMinSafe(p_used)][1],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(min_p = dplyr::if_else(is.finite(min_p), min_p, NA_real_),
                  significant = !is.na(stageR_gene) & stageR_gene < alpha[[r]],
                  symbol = unname(gene_symbol[gene_id]))
}) %>% stats::setNames(runs)

# Others
## Shared cell type order and contrasts
celltype_levels <- dplyr::bind_rows(results) %>% dplyr::count(celltype, sort = TRUE) %>% dplyr::pull(celltype)
celltype_levels <- union(celltype_levels, unique(unlist(lapply(diagnostics, function(d) d$celltype))))
contrast_levels <- unique(unlist(lapply(diagnostics, function(d) d$contrast)))

## Sample table: group and stratum of each sample
samples <- readr::read_tsv(sample_table_path, col_types = readr::cols(
  .default = readr::col_guess(), sample_id = readr::col_character(), group = readr::col_character()))
missing_cols <- setdiff(c("sample_id", "group", stratify_by), colnames(samples))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop("Columns missing from the sample table: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
samples <- samples %>%
  dplyr::mutate(stratum = if (is.null(stratify_by)) "all" else as.character(.data[[stratify_by]])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!sample_id %in% exclude_samples) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group, stratum)
if (length(contrast_groups) > 0) samples <- dplyr::filter(samples, group %in% contrast_groups)

## Pseudobulks and nuclei per pseudobulk sample
pseudobulks <- lapply(pseudobulk_paths, readRDS)
n_cells <- lapply(n_cells_paths, function(p) {
  readr::read_tsv(p, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character(), n_cells = readr::col_double())) %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_id, celltype, n_cells)
})
```

# Run Settings

## Comparison

What is being compared across all runs studied in this report. These values are defined in the ENDome configuration under `sc_dataset`:

```{r comparison-table, echo = FALSE}
comparison_keys <- c("stratify_by", "celltypes", "contrasts", "covariates", "exclude_samples")
tibble::tibble(
  Setting = comparison_keys,
  Value = vapply(comparison_keys, function(k) fmtSetting(comparison[[k]]), character(1))
) %>%
  renderTable(style = "md", caption = "Comparison settings (sc_dataset).")
```

## Runs {`r tab_class`}

Settings for each run as specified in the ENDome configuration:

```{r, results='asis', echo = FALSE}
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run){
  info <- run_info[run_info$run == run, ]
  settingsTbl <- function(s, block) {
    if (is.null(s)) return(tibble::tibble(Block = block, Setting = "-", Value = "not in the config"))
    tibble::tibble(Block = block, Setting = names(s), Value = vapply(s, fmtSetting, character(1)))
  }
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    settingsTbl(pseudobulk_settings[[info$pseudobulk]], paste0("pseudobulk: ", info$pseudobulk)),
    settingsTbl(satuRn_settings[[info$profile]], paste0("satuRn: ", info$profile))
  ) %>% 
    renderTable(style = "md", caption = sprintf("Settings of the `%s` run.", info$label))
})
```

# `satuRn` Fits

This section presents information regarding each of the satuRn fits performed in the analysis, where each fit compares the stratum and cell type between every contrast specified. A fit can be skipped when a group has too few samples with enough nuclei or when too few genes survive the transcript filtering step.

## Overview of tests {`r tab_class`}

The following table reports how many tests ran and how many were skipped, how many genes and bins they tested, which p-values they used, and how many genes and bins came out significant. 

```{r fits-summary, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  d <- diagnostics[[run]]
  ok <- d %>% dplyr::filter(status == "ok")
  sig <- genes[[run]] %>% dplyr::filter(significant)
  tibble::tibble(
    Metric = c("Tests (fit x contrast)", "Tests that ran", "Tests skipped",
               paste0(stratum_name, " x cell types that ran"), "Genes tested (sum over tests)", "Bins tested (sum over tests)",
               "Tests using empirical p-values", "Tests using raw p-values",
               "Significant genes (sum over tests)", "Distinct significant genes", "Significant bins (sum over tests)"),
    Value = c(fmtInt(nrow(d)), fmtInt(nrow(ok)), fmtInt(sum(d$status != "ok")),
              fmtInt(dplyr::n_distinct(paste(ok$stratum, ok$celltype))),
              fmtInt(sum(ok$n_genes_tested, na.rm = TRUE)), fmtInt(sum(ok$n_bins_tested, na.rm = TRUE)),
              fmtInt(sum(ok$p_type == "empirical", na.rm = TRUE)), fmtInt(sum(ok$p_type == "raw", na.rm = TRUE)),
              fmtInt(nrow(sig)), fmtInt(dplyr::n_distinct(sig$gene_id)),
              fmtInt(sum(results[[run]]$stageR_transcript < alpha[[run]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  ) %>%
    renderTable(style = "md", caption = sprintf("Fits of the `%s` run (alpha = %s).", run_labels[[run]], alpha[[run]]))
})
```

## Skipped tests {`r tab_class`}

The following table reports the cell types that never reached `satuRn`, by `r tolower(stratum_name)` and contrast.

```{r fits-skipped, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
merge_reasons <- c(
  samples = "Too few samples per group",
  genes = "Too few genes after filtering",
  design = "Rank-deficient design",
  error = "Error in the fit"
)

mergeReason <- function(status) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("samples with", status) ~ merge_reasons[["samples"]],
    grepl("genes", status) ~ merge_reasons[["genes"]],
    grepl("rank-deficient", status) ~ merge_reasons[["design"]],
    grepl("^error", status) ~ merge_reasons[["error"]],
    TRUE ~ status
  )
}

renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  d <- diagnostics[[run]] %>% dplyr::filter(status != "ok")
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { cat("No test was skipped.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(reason = mergeReason(status)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast_levels)) %>% 
    dplyr::count(stratum, contrast, reason, name = "tests_skipped") %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(stratum, contrast, reason) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = paste0(stratum, " - ", contrast), .before = 0) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Contrast = group, Reason = reason, `Tests skipped` = tests_skipped) %>% 
    renderTable(style = "md", caption = sprintf("Skipped tests of the %s run.", run_labels[[run]])) %>% 
    kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")
})
```

```{r fits-table, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {

    dplyr::arrange(stratum, celltype, contrast) %>%

                  Genes = n_genes_tested, Bins = n_bins_tested, `P-values` = p_type, 
                  `Raw p < 0.05` = frac_raw_p05, `Empirical p < 0.05` = frac_emp_p05,
```

# Calibration of the different tests

`satuRn` computes for every contrast with at least 500 bins and *empirical* null. That is, a normal distribution with mean `delta` and standard deviation `sigma` fitted to the bulk of the test statistics. A sigma above 1 means that the raw statistics are more spread than the theory expects. While empirical p-values remove that excess, it also removes a real, broad shift. Whether to use the raw p-value or the empirical ones can be decided in the `satuRn_preset`.

## Spread of the empirical null per test {`r tab_class`}

The `sigma` of every test with an empirical null, by cell type, contrast and `r tolower(stratum_name)`. The dashed line is a perfectly calibrated test (sigma = 1). Points far to the right are tests whose significance depends heavily on the empirical correction.

```{r calibration-sigma, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=11}
run <- runs[[1]]

renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  d <- diagnostics[[run]] %>% dplyr::filter(status == "ok", !is.na(null_sigma))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { cat("No test has an empirical null (all have fewer than 500 bins).\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  d %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = null_sigma, y = forcats::fct_rev(celltype), fill = stratum, shape = contrast)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorsFor(d$stratum, col_stratum)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("PDDvsControl" = 22, "PDvsControl" = 23, "PDDvsPD" = 24)) +
    labs(x = "Empirical null sigma", y = NULL, fill = stratum_name, shape = "Contrast",
         title = "Spread of the empirical null", subtitle = sprintf("Run: %s", run_labels[[run]])) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
    theme_endome(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )
})
```

## Distribution of bin p-values {`r tab_class`}

Raw and empirical bin p-values of every test by contrast. Under no signal, both are flat. An excess near 0 in the raw p-values should be removed by the empirical correction.

```{r calibration-pvalues, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height=5}
edgeLabels <- function(axis = "x") structure(list(axis = axis), class = "edgeLabels")
ggplot_add.edgeLabels <- function(object, plot, ...) {
  axis <- object$axis
  breaks <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(plot)$layout$panel_params[[1]][[axis]]$get_breaks()
  n <- sum(!is.na(breaks))
  just <- if (n < 2) rep(0.5, n) else c(0, rep(0.5, n - 2), 1)
  el <- if (axis == "x") ggplot2::element_text(hjust = just) else ggplot2::element_text(vjust = just)
  plot + suppressWarnings(do.call(ggplot2::theme, stats::setNames(list(el), paste0("axis.text.", axis))))
}
registerS3method("ggplot_add", "edgeLabels", ggplot_add.edgeLabels, envir = asNamespace("ggplot2"))

run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  p <- results[[run]] %>%
    dplyr::select(contrast, Raw = pval, Empirical = empirical_pval) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Raw, Empirical), names_to = "type", values_to = "p") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p))
  if (nrow(p) == 0) { cat("No p-values in this run.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  p %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Raw", "Empirical"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = p)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(fill = contrast), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorsFor(p$contrast, col_contrast), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(), labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult= c(0, 0.1))) +
    facet_grid(type ~ contrast, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Bin p-value", y = "# Bins", title = "P-value distributions", subtitle = sprintf("Run: %s", run_labels[[run]])) +
    theme_endome() +
    theme(
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines")
    )
})
```

## Gene significance by cell type {`r tab_class`}

The stage-wise adjusted gene p-value on a -log10 scale is presented for every tested gene by cell type. Colored genes are significant, and the label marks the most significant gene of each cell type. If the genes of interest are significant, they are also presented labelled.

```{r dtu-swarm, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
run <- runs[[1]]

renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  g <- genes[[run]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(stageR_gene)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels), y = nlog10(stageR_gene))
  
  if (nrow(g) == 0) { cat("No gene has a stageR p-value in this run.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  labels <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    g %>% 
      dplyr::filter(significant) %>% 
      dplyr::group_by(stratum, contrast, celltype) %>% 
      dplyr::slice_max(y, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% dplyr::ungroup(),
    g %>% 
      dplyr::filter(symbol %in% genes_of_interest, significant)
  ) %>% dplyr::distinct()
  
  ggplot(g, aes(x = celltype, y = y)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha[[run]]), linetype = 2, colour = "red") +
    geom_jitter(data = dplyr::filter(g, !significant), colour = col_not_sig, width = 0.25, height = 0, size = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(data = dplyr::filter(g, significant), colour = col_sig, width = 0.25, height = 0, size = 1.2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = labels, aes(label = symbol), size = 2.6, max.overlaps = 30, min.segment.length = 0) +
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(contrast ~ stratum, strip = stratumStrips(g$stratum)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "-log10 stageR gene p-value", title = "Gene significance per cell type",
         subtitle = sprintf("Run: %s | dashed line: alpha = %s", run_labels[[run]], alpha[[run]])) +
    theme_endome() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
})
```

```{r dtu-volcano, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, eval=FALSE}
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  v <- results[[run]] %>%

  top_ct <- results[[run]] %>%

  vv <- v %>%

    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label = unname(gene_symbol[gene_id]))
  
  vv %>%

                        labels = c(`FALSE` = "Not significant", `TRUE` = "Significant")) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested(

  v %>%

      contrast ~ stratum + celltype,

    ) +

})
```

# Bin Usage of Selected Genes

Proportion of each gene's counts that falls in each of its bins, per pseudobulk sample and group, in the `r tolower(stratum_name)` and cell type where the gene is most significant. As in the fits, only the samples of that `r tolower(stratum_name)` with at least the profile's `min_cells` nuclei of that cell type are shown. Bins are labelled by the rank of their ENDome end (`E1` = most upstream).

```{r usage-helpers}
#' Per-sample bin usage of a set of (stratum, cell type, gene) tests, from the run's pseudobulk
#'
#' @param run Run
#' @param tests Tibble with stratum, celltype, gene_id and symbol
#' @return One row per sample x bin with the bin's share of the gene's counts, or NULL
usageData <- function(run, tests) {
  pb_name <- run_info$pseudobulk[run_info$run == run]
  pb <- pseudobulks[[pb_name]]
  if (is.null(pb) || nrow(tests) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  min_cells <- as.numeric(runSetting(run, "min_cells", default_min_cells))
  rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(pb))
  purrr::pmap_dfr(tests, function(stratum, celltype, gene_id, symbol, ...){
    bins <- rownames(pb)[rd$gene_id == gene_id]
    if (length(bins) < 2 || !celltype %in% assayNames(pb)) return(NULL)

    ## Samples of the stratum with >= min_cells nuclei of the cell type
    keep <- samples$sample_id[samples$stratum == stratum]
    if (!is.null(n_cells[[pb_name]])){
      enough <- n_cells[[pb_name]] %>% 
        dplyr::filter(.data$celltype == .env$celltype, n_cells >= min_cells) %>% 
        dplyr::pull(sample_id)
      keep <- intersect(keep, enough)
    }
    keep <- intersect(colnames(pb), keep)

    X <- as.matrix(assay(pb, celltype)[bins, keep, drop = FALSE])
    X <- X[, colSums(X) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(X) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    bin_label <- if ("end_rank" %in% colnames(rd)) paste0("E", rd[bins, "end_rank"]) else bins
    tibble::tibble(
      panel = paste0(symbol, " - ", celltype, " - ", stratum),
      bin = rep(bin_label, times = ncol(X)),
      sample_id = rep(colnames(X), each = length(bins)),
      usage = as.vector(sweep(X, 2, colSums(X), "/"))
    ) %>% dplyr::left_join(samples %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, group), by = "sample_id")
  })
}

usagePlot <- function(u, title, subtitle) {
  if (is.null(u) || nrow(u) == 0) { cat("No sample to show.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  ggplot(u, aes(x = bin, y = usage, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = "Bin", y = "Share of the gene's counts", fill = "Group", title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_endome()
}
```

## Bin usage of the genes of interest **NOT IMPLENTED** {`r tab_class`}

Genes of interest: `r paste(genes_of_interest, collapse = ", ")`. The table lists every test of these genes, with the gene's rank within its test; the figure shows their usage in the test where each is most significant.

```{r usage-goi, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5.5}
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  g <- genes[[run]] %>% dplyr::filter(symbol %in% genes_of_interest)
  if (nrow(g) == 0) { cat("None of the genes of interest was tested in this run.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  ranks <- genes[[run]] %>%
    dplyr::group_by(stratum, celltype, contrast) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = rank(min_p, ties.method = "min", na.last = "keep"), n_genes = dplyr::n()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(stratum, celltype, contrast, gene_id, rank, n_genes)
  
  tbl <- g %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ranks, by = c("stratum", "celltype", "contrast", "gene_id")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(symbol, stageR_gene, min_p) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Gene = symbol, stratum, `Cell type` = celltype, Contrast = contrast,
                     `stageR gene p` = fmtP(stageR_gene), `Min. p` = fmtP(min_p),
                     Rank = paste0(rank, " / ", n_genes), `Sig. bins` = n_sig_bins, Significant = significant) %>%
    showStratum() %>%
    renderTable(style = "html", caption = sprintf("Genes of interest in the `%s` run.", run_labels[[run]]))
  knitr::knit_print(tbl)
  
  best <- g %>% dplyr::group_by(symbol) %>% dplyr::slice_min(min_p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  usagePlot(
    usageData(run, 
              best %>% 
                dplyr::select(stratum, celltype, gene_id, symbol)),
    "Bin usage of the genes of interest", 
    sprintf("Run: %s | test with the smallest p-value of each gene", run_labels[[run]]))
})
```

## Bin usage of the top `r top_genes` genes **NOT IMPLENTED** {`r tab_class`}

The `r top_genes` most significant tests of each run (by stageR gene p-value, then smallest bin p-value), one gene per test, so a gene significant in several cell types appears only once.

```{r usage-top, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height = 7}
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  top <- genes[[run]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(min_p)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(stageR_gene, min_p) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_genes)
  usagePlot(usageData(run, top %>% dplyr::select(stratum, celltype, gene_id, symbol)),
            "Bin usage of the top genes", sprintf("Run: %s", run_labels[[run]]))
})
```

# Comparison Between Runs

<!-- How each run agrees with the others, over the tests (`r tolower(stratum_name)` x cell type x contrast) and genes that both ran. The rank concordance uses the smallest bin p-value of each gene, which is available whatever the p-values used for the significance calls. -->

## Overlap of significant genes with the other runs **NOT IMPLENTED** {`r tab_class`}

<!-- For each other run: the tests and genes both runs tested, the significant gene x test pairs in each and in both, their Jaccard index, and the Spearman correlation of the genes' smallest bin p-values. -->

```{r compare-table, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
keys <- c("stratum", "celltype", "contrast", "gene_id")
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  other_runs <- setdiff(runs, run)
  if (length(other_runs) == 0) { cat("Only one run: nothing to compare.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  purrr::map_dfr(other_runs, function(other_run) {
    j <- dplyr::inner_join(genes[[run]], genes[[other_run]], by = keys, suffix = c("_r", "_o"))
    sig_r <- sum(genes[[run]]$significant); sig_o <- sum(genes[[other_run]]$significant)
    both <- sum(j$significant_r & j$significant_o)
    tibble::tibble(
      `Compared with` = run_labels[[other_run]],
      `Shared tests` = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(j$stratum, j$celltype, j$contrast)),
      `Shared genes tested` = nrow(j),
      `Sig. here` = sig_r, `Sig. there` = sig_o, `Sig. in both` = both,
      Jaccard = round(both / max(1, sig_r + sig_o - both), 3),
      `Spearman (min. p)` = round(suppressWarnings(stats::cor(j$min_p_r, j$min_p_o, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")), 3)
    )
  }) %>%
    renderTable(style = "md", caption = sprintf("Agreement of the `%s` run with the other runs (significant gene x test pairs).", run_labels[[run]]))
})
```

## Gene p-values against the other runs **NOT IMPLENTED** {`r tab_class`}

<!-- Smallest bin p-value of every gene tested in both runs (-log10), this run on the x axis, coloured by where the gene is significant. Points on the diagonal behave the same in both runs. -->

```{r compare-scatter, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, fig.height = 6}
run <- runs[[1]]
renderTabsetByRun(function(run) {
  other_runs <- setdiff(runs, run)
  if (length(other_runs) == 0) { cat("Only one run: nothing to compare.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  j <- purrr::map_dfr(other_runs, function(other_run) {
    dplyr::inner_join(genes[[run]], genes[[other_run]], by = keys, suffix = c("_r", "_o")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(other = run_labels[[other_run]])
  }) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(min_p_r), !is.na(min_p_o))
  if (nrow(j) == 0) { cat("No gene was tested in this run and another.\n\n"); return(NULL) }
  j %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = factor(dplyr::case_when(significant_r & significant_o ~ "Both",
                                                   significant_r ~ "This run only",
                                                   significant_o ~ "Other run only",
                                                   TRUE ~ "Neither"),
                                  levels = names(col_overlap))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(status) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = nlog10(min_p_r), y = nlog10(min_p_o), colour = status)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_overlap) +
    facet_wrap(~ other) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = "-log10 min. bin p-value (this run)", y = "-log10 min. bin p-value (other run)", colour = "Significant in",
         title = "Gene significance across runs", subtitle = sprintf("Run: %s", run_labels[[run]])) +
    theme_endome()
})
```
